title: Grant only the access needed

body.text: MCP lets AI touch real data, so manage permissions carefully. The
principle: allow access only to the folders/data that are needed, and give 'read-only' access if editing isn't required — reducing the risk of data damage.

example: Connect MCP with read-only access to the reports folder, with no permission to delete or edit files

title: Trust only verified servers

body.text: , because a server can access your data. Check who made it and what it can do before connecting — just like installing any plugin: an unknown one could be a vulnerability.

example: Before installing a server → check the developer, the permissions it requests, and reviews, before allowing data access
